lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately 4 to 5 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a quasi-rectangular grid posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming distinct anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light intensity on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin displays a high-density clustering of small, irregularly distributed high-luminance spots that differ in spatial frequency from the flank grid.
